newsitem.title: USA: Belco drops bid for Hugoton Energy.
newsitem.headline: Belco drops bid for Hugoton Energy.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp. said Monday it withdrew its conditional proposal to acquire the rest of Hugoton Energy Corp. for about $271 million, but it offered no reason for its decision.
Belco, an independent energy company based in New York, also said it released Hugoton from its agreement to negotiate exclusively with Belco through July 11 with respect to a sale of Hugoton.

Hugoton, an independent oil and natural gas company based in Wichita, Kan., issued a statement saying it had been notified of Belco's decision and would continue to evaluate its various strategic alternatives.

Belco, which had 2.9 million shares of Hugoton common stock, or about 14.9 percent, had offered to acquire the rest of the outstanding stock for a combination of $5 in cash and $10 worth of Belco stock for each share of Hugoton.
Hugoton's stock lost $1.875 to $12 in early trading on the Nasdaq market while Belco gave up 25 cents to $21.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
